notes.note: 18 disposals for Noble in a quieter game from him. His last four games have been very inconsistent in terms of scoring for him.
Noble was much better this week after two quieter games. 13 marks and 33 disposals at 84%. It was a big third quarter that really helped his score.
Many coaches went to Noble after the Sinclair injury but this week he was just at 16 disposals with 62% efficiency which hurt. He was again on the wing and he also had no stats in the first term.
Noble was everywhere and has now got three in a row over 125 with this one being his biggest as just 1 of his 31 disposals was ineffective. A great outing for him.
